course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Summarize a short announcement using source-framing phrases.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Understanding and relaying a building, transport, course, or community announcement.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing the main point and the practical consequence of a short source.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik read or hear a short notice about changed opening hours and discuss what it means for their plan.

main_focus.name: source framing with enligt and det står att
main_focus.description: Use phrases such as enligt meddelandet and det står att to frame information from a short source.
model_examples: Enligt meddelandet stänger receptionen tidigare i dag.
Det står att man kan boka en ny tid online.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use source-framing phrases 3-4 times and keep the summary to the most important practical points.

allowed_supporting_grammar: passive awareness in notices if natural
avoid_grammar: source criticism as the main task

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use announcement vocabulary and summary chunks rather than adding unrelated details.

dialogue_shape.opening: A short announcement or notice is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They identify the main point, explain what it means, and connect it to their original plan.
dialogue_shape.ending: They state the practical consequence in one clear summary.

target_complexity.repetition: Reported content can support the source framing, but the lesson should not become a news debate.

focus: the main point of the announcement
the practical consequence for the plan
which option remains available after the change

sentence_focus: one sentence with det står att
one sentence naming the most important point
one sentence with det betyder att
one sentence stating the practical next step
